research.method: All values come from FIBA's official statistics service behind fiba.basketball (the public data API the site's history pages call). For every team the player list comes from getgdapcompetitionteamstatisticsbyteamid; each player's totals are the sum of his per-game rows from getgdapplayergamestatisticsbyplayerid, restricted to the 42 games of this tournament listed by getgdapgamesbycompetitionid. Birth dates come from getgdapplayerinfobycompetitionid (fallback: the team roster). FIBA records minutes in whole minutes for these events.
research.add_up_check: Each team's summed player points equal the points in its game scores (difference listed per team in team_totals[].check).
research.bbr_matching: bbr_id is set only for keys of library/careers/nba_player_careers.json with an NBA season in 2003-04, 2004-05 or 2005-06, matched by name and then reviewed by hand (birth date and team) for every hand-made match; players whose NBA careers ended before 2003-04 have no careers key and keep bbr_id null (noted on the record).
notes: 8 team-games record zero team blocks while other categories are recorded; kept as real zeros (a team can finish a game without a block), not as missing data.

United States roster is the real-history 2004 Olympic team, including the real Dwyane Wade (protagonist_real_history). The career's Wade is alternate history; his row here is world data only and must never feed the simulated Wade.
conflicts: Basketball-Reference's 2004 Olympic totals table (143 rows) agrees with FIBA for 134 of the 143 matched players in every category; the 9 small differences (one or two counts, or an appearance FIBA lists with zero minutes vs. a BBR appearance) are listed in cross_check.differences. FIBA's values are kept. Peter Ramos (Puerto Rico; FIBA: 4 games, 33 minutes, 7 points) is missing from the Basketball-Reference table.
research.minutes_reconciliation: FIBA rounds each player's minutes to whole minutes, so a team's game total can be 1-2 minutes off 200 (or 225/250 with overtime). Teams whose totals are off by more than rounding plus whole overtimes: Angola: 1195 minutes in 6 games (-5 vs 200 a game); Lithuania: 1596 minutes in 8 games (-4 vs 200 a game); Puerto Rico: 1389 minutes in 7 games (-11 vs 200 a game)
